name: Oliver Collins
title: Psychophysiology and the Perception of Reality
summary: An Undergraduate Psychology student at the University of Sussex on track to obtain a First-Class degree, with over 1,200 hours of research experience. Research interests include the relationship between cognition and physiology (in particular cardiovascular signals), computational cognitive modelling, metascience, as well as the development of software to facilitate psychophysiological research. Experience in developing human-computer interfaces combining physiological signals and music as a line of side projects.

experience.degree: BSc in Psychology with Clinical Approaches with a Professional Placement Year

hook: Did you know that Oliver created a facial EMG-based guitar controller?
